short: Cohomology bound on windows for all characters

statements.markdown: Statement 8.1 (VVle, VWin). For the host field E at scale x, with t 0 = ⌊x 401 ⌋ twists, every len ℓ (e) with 1 ≤ e < t 0 is finite and √ X X log ℓ len ℓ (e) ≤ b, b = exp(x ε ), 1≤e<t 0 ℓ for all x in a window [Y 1 , Y 1 2 ]; there is J ≥ 1 such that for every large X such a window lies in [X 1/J , X].

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.VVle
lean.plain: Bound the sum of twisted cohomology lengths
lean.fidelity_note: For fixed field, twist cutoff, and bound, `VVle` requires finite length for each prime and twist and bounds every finite sum over primes. The summands are nonnegative, so this captures the full sum. The scale and window conditions are in `VWin`.

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.VWin
lean.plain: Cohomology bound on windows for all characters
lean.note: `VWin` fixes exponent 401 and quantifies over each primitive character, $0<\varepsilon<1/52$, and each cyclotomic layer choice satisfying `PageN`. For each eligible prime pair at $X^{1/J}$, the window may depend on that pair. Its bound holds for every matching host at each scale in the window. The paper leaves this order of host choices implicit.

statements.markdown: The only assumption about ψ is its cohomological bound. The windows come from Statement 8.1, which holds on windows [Y 1 , Y 1 2 ]; this is why Statement 4.1 is needed in its windowed form.

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.supplyChi
lean.plain: Build hosts from a cohomology window bound
lean.note: SupplyChi.lean:8–11 takes only VWinAt ψ 401. Its proof invokes supplyOfAdm, which gets windows of exponent 3/2 through winPairs and the proved good-pair supply.

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.VWin
lean.plain: Cohomology bound on windows for all characters
lean.note: ExistsPageN.lean:44–49 packages VWinAt ψ 401 for each primitive ψ. VWinAt supplies the square window for eligible prime pairs and each choice of PageN schedule. WinPairs.lean:34–52 fits the rescaled exponent-3/2 window inside it.
